mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 52 degrees and clear at Fireman's Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. The International Space Station will be visible for one minute starting at 5:05 AM, rising over Verona High School in the northwest before heading toward the Home Depot area in the northeast.

City news today highlights ongoing engineering services provided by AECOM Incorporated, with reports shared at council meetings. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting meetings on November 18 and 19 regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather community feedback on new design concepts.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, you can enjoy music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, celebrate with Main Street Trick or Treat, catch some comedy at ART House, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia.

In our weekly police report, on October 21, officers assisted fire and EMS crews at two separate cardiac arrest calls on Batker Court and Basswood Avenue, where they were able to provide life-saving assistance.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your stop accordingly to enjoy this classic treat.
